name: Reggie's Camel Camp Dining
why_it_matters: Pioneering luxury tented camp 60 km from Jodhpur, in the Thar dunes overlooking the 8th-century Osian temple town — pitched as 'India's first luxury tented camp'. Owns its kitchen garden; multiple dining setups (open fire, tented dining tent, under the stars).
insider_tip: The in-house Rajasthani musicians do a one-hour set most evenings — confirm at booking; the kitchen times the courses to that performance, not the other way around.
signature_address: Reggie's Camel Camp, near Osian, Jodhpur District, Rajasthan 342303

name: Manvar Sevan Desert Camp Dining
why_it_matters: Manvar Sevan is the desert camp wing of the Manvar Resort group at Dechu, near Osian — central dining tent serves a Rajasthani-Indian buffet with barbeque add-ons in the cooler months. Lower price point than the Shergarh resort building.
insider_tip: Manvar has three properties under the same name — confirm whether your booking is the Sevan tents (cheaper, more rustic) or Shergarh resort (rooms with AC) before arriving for dinner.
signature_address: Manvar Sevan Desert Camp, Khetsingh Nagar, Dechu, Jodhpur District, Rajasthan 342303
